name: explain-pr
description: Explain a GitHub pull request as a source-backed walkthrough: execution-ordered flowchart, optional 3D follow mode, every step pinned to file/line evidence at the PR's commits.

interface.shortDescription: Walk a PR's logic step by step, pinned to code
interface.longDescription: Turns a GitHub pull request into a walkthrough a reader follows one request at a time: an execution-ordered flowchart with branches and failure paths, an optional 3D follow mode, and file/line evidence at the PR's exact commits for every step. Verifies its own citations, marks what it did not read, and never issues merge verdicts.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through this PR with 3d
What does this PR change at runtime?
